about: Pairs each strategic bet Kroger describes in its SEC filings with the Giant Eagle app-review area it touches. Kroger agreed on July 1, 2026 to acquire Giant Eagle (close expected fiscal 2027); Giant Eagle is private, so Kroger's filings are the investor source. Quotes are verbatim from the linked filing. Readings are drafts.

rows.quote: eCommerce sales growth was led by strong demand for our Delivery solutions.
rows.reading: Delivery complaints are about fees (time-slot charges, a bag fee, an Instacart comparison), tips that can't be edited, and missing or crushed items; on-time drivers get praise. Pickup draws more praise than delivery.

rows.quote: We also provide relevant customer-facing apps and interfaces that have the features customers want and that are also reliable, easy to use and deliver a seamless customer experience across our store and digital channels.
rows.reading: Reviewers describe crashes, lag, and reinstalling to fix the app, often right after a named update. Kroger's own bar of reliable, easy-to-use apps is the bar these would be held to.

rows.bet: Loyalty card on nearly every transaction
rows.quote: Kroger serves approximately 63 million households annually, and because of our rewards program, over 95% of customer transactions are tethered to a Kroger loyalty card.
rows.reading: Points are liked; reaching the card is not. Reviewers ask for a Wallet pass or widget and describe being signed out at the register. A card used on nearly every transaction has to open fast.

rows.quote: We utilize the data and traffic generated by our retail business to create personalized experiences and value for our customers.
rows.reading: Reviewers praise coupons that light up on products, but object to removed filters and expiry dates, promo codes that fail, and sale prices not applied. Personalized offers depend on that plumbing working.

rows.quote: Kroger will deliver more value for customers through a self-funded plan.
rows.reading: Several reviewers say Giant Eagle runs pricier than Heinen's or Trader Joe's and that sale items run out; others praise quality. A value push would land on an existing price perception.

rows.bet: Pharmacy, Fresh and Our Brands drive sales
rows.quote: We achieved strong results in 2025, driven by continued performance in eCommerce and pharmacy along with momentum in Fresh and Our Brands.
rows.reading: Complaints are about prescription refill setup that won't load and a second sign-in for the pharmacy; pharmacy staff get praise. One reviewer hopes the Kroger deal brings modernization.

rows.quote: Additionally, we invested in service and labor hours to ensure that our stores are well-staffed, and we remain focused on equipping our associates with the tools, technology, data, and support needed to serve customers well.
rows.reading: Staff and curbside reviews are almost all praise, often naming the associate. Reviewers value the people more than any app feature.

rows.quote: it will acquire Giant Eagle, Inc. (“Giant Eagle”) for a purchase price of approximately $1.65 billion, subject to customary purchase price adjustments.
rows.reading: The filings say nothing about Giant Eagle's app or myPerks. Reviewers already compare the app with Kroger's, and one blames Kroger for a removed feature before the deal has closed.
